name: Launch UI
notes: Freemium. The open-source MIT core (GitHub repo launch-ui/launch-ui + public shadcn registry at https://www.launchuicomponents.com/r/registry.json) covers 16 of the 24 documented items: 9 section blocks (navbar, hero, items, logos, faq, cta, stats, pricing, footer), 5 components (button, badge, screenshot, mockup, glow) and the base package (launchui: globals.css, utils incl. fade/glass, Section wrapper). 8 documented items are Launch UI Pro (one-time $99 personal / $499 team): sections bento-grid, feature, social-proof, testimonials, tabs, carousel, gallery and the Card component - their registry entries expose 0 files and source is not public; Pro installs require a purchased license. Docs also document 74 Pro block variants vs 9 free blocks (one 'default' variant each). Install pattern: 'npx shadcn@latest add @launchui/<block>' after the base; full template via 'npx shadcn@latest init --base radix --template next --no-monorepo --preset nova --name my-app' or the GitHub template (branch tailwind-3 for Tailwind v3). Repo active (last push 2026-06, 842 stars). Docs taxonomy: Sections / Components / Utilities.
